title: Sarfatti's claimed non-human intelligence experience

tellings.quote: except he's been on this problem for 50 years when he first claimed he had a UFO or Ali non-human intelligence experience

plain: Bob Maguire, described as a former contractor for the CIA, the US spy agency, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about a man named Jack Sarfatti. Maguire says Sarfatti has been working on the question of alien contact for about 50 years, ever since he first claimed, in the 1970s, to have had an experience with a UFO or some non-human intelligence.
